Question: A 22-year-old Caucasian female presents with severe right lower quadrant pain, malaise, and diarrhea. The entire wall of the region is thickened and inflamed, which may directly lead to formation of:?

opa. Fistulas
opb. Toxic megacolon
opc. Widening of the intestinal lumen
